trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the roadmap in order — story first, then side stories, then activities and collectibles — and check the progress bar in this guide as you go. Nothing about it is missable on its own; it only waits on everything else. The whole platinum takes around 200 hours, so pace it rather than rushing the grind.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000. trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars.
